issue_data.body:
We use `plugins=["url"]` so plain URLs in user comments become links. Two problems keep coming up: 1. Wikipedia links with parentheses get cut: ```python md = mistune.create_markdown(plugins=["url"]) md("see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Python_(programming_language) for details") ``` gives ```html

see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Python_(programming_language) for details

``` so the link goes to a 404 page. 2. When someone asks a question ending with a link, the `?` becomes part of the URL: ```python md("did you try https://example.com/docs?") # https://example.com/docs? ``` Same with `!`. A period or comma at the end is already handled correctly, so I guess `?` and `!` were just missed. GitHub keeps balanced parentheses in the URL and drops trailing punctuation like `?` and `!`.
